title: In vitro investigation of biophysical interactions between Ag(I) complexes of bis(methyl)(thia/selena)salen and ct-DNA via multi-spectroscopic, physicochemical and molecular docking methods along with cytotoxicity study.
authors: Tripathi, Mamta; Syed, Rabbani; Stalin, Antony; Malik, Abdul; Pande, Rama; Asatkar, Ashish K
journal: Luminescence : the journal of biological and chemical luminescence
one_liner_zh: 该文通过光谱、粘度法和分子对接研究Ag(I)配合物与ct-DNA的沟槽结合，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作建模方法，但对象为小分子-DNA体系，非TF-DNA，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Four silver(I) (Ag(I)) complexes: 1.PF(6) , 2.PF(6) , 1.ClO(4) and 2.ClO(4) of bis(methyl)thia salen (1) and bis (methyl)selena salen (2) with two different counter anions (PF(6) (-) and ClO(4) (-) ) have been investigated for DNA binding properties. In vitro interactional association between the Ag(I) complexes and ct-DNA has been examined by performing spectroscopic titrations on absorption spectrophotometer and fluorescence spectrophotometer. A competitive binding study has also been done using a fluorescence spectrophotometer with ethidium bromide as a classical intercalator. The spectroscopic methods revealed a major groove. Viscometry and agarose gel electrophoresis experiments have also been performed as physicochemical methods to confirm the binding of complex molecules with DNA. Molecular docking analysis has been executed to obtain the theoretical insight into the mode of binding. The docking study demonstrated the major groove binding of all four complexes to the DNA with electrostatic metal-phosphate interactions (between the metal and the backbone of DNA) and hydrophobic interactions. Cytotoxicity of the complexes has been studied on the Human Fibroblast foreskin (HFF) cell line. The cytotoxicity results showed positive gesture for moving ahead to the next level of screening; the values were above 10 muM which are appreciated for the normal cell lines.
abstract_zh: 四种银(I)（Ag(I)）配合物：1.PF(6)、2.PF(6)、1.ClO(4)和2.ClO(4)，由双(甲基)硫杂萨伦（1）和双(甲基)硒杂萨伦（2）与两种不同抗衡阴离子（PF(6) (-) 和 ClO(4) (-)）组成，已对其DNA结合性质进行了研究。通过吸收分光光度计和荧光分光光度计上的光谱滴定，考察了Ag(I)配合物与ct-DNA之间的体外相互作用关联。还使用荧光分光光度计进行了竞争性结合研究，以溴化乙锭作为经典嵌入剂。光谱方法揭示了主要沟槽结合。此外，还进行了粘度测定和琼脂糖凝胶电泳实验，作为物理化学方法以确认配合物分子与DNA的结合。分子对接分析已执行，以获得结合模式的理论见解。对接研究表明，所有四种配合物均以主要沟槽方式与DNA结合，涉及静电金属-磷酸盐相互作用（金属与DNA骨架之间）和疏水相互作用。配合物的细胞毒性已在人包皮成纤维细胞（HFF）细胞系上进行了研究。细胞毒性结果显示，向下一阶段筛选迈进的积极迹象；其值高于10 μM，这对于正常细胞系而言是可接受的。
